trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction call where the customer is cooperative throughout and gives the rep an easy path to a booked appointment. The rep executes the verify sequence quickly but skips the interest-question and bill-anchor entirely, and answers a live pricing question with a bare deflection instead of using it as a hook. The call ends booked but thin — the rep leaves real curiosity-building and cross-sell material (new-build home, no bill yet) unused.
outcome_dispute: The v1 tag is unknown/unclear; based on the transcript this is clearly a booked appointment with day and time both stated (tomorrow at 2PM), so it should be tagged booked, not tentative or callback.
